layers.description:
Biodiversity richness surface summarizing ecosystem-level species richness across the country.

[Inserta la espanol aqui]
Species distribution raster collection for potential species explorer

Contiene la delimitación oficial de los complejos de páramo su propósito es servir de referencia oficial para la gestión ambiental, la planificación territorial, la conservación y el manejo sostenible de los ecosistemas de alta montaña.
La delimitación geográfica de los humedales continentales de Colombia a escala 1:100.000.
La distribución geográfica de los ecosistemas de bosque seco tropical en Colombia, elaborada a escala 1:100.000
Highlights mangrove ecosystems that support coastal protection and local livelihoods.
Descripcion de biomas y ecosistemas a escala 1:100.000
Shows projected human footprint intensity to provide pressure context across the landscape.
Shows potential agricultural net benefit; higher values indicate higher opportunity cost for conservation.
Protected areas from RUNAP (2023) that are treated as already conserved in planning outputs.
Other Effective Conservation Measures (OMECs) recognized for conservation outcomes outside formal protected areas.
Afro-Colombian community territories that can be included in planning and visualization.
Indigenous reserves include mask currently not exposed
National country polygon boundary served as local GeoJSON.
Department AOI boundaries served from IGAC
Municipality AOI boundaries served from IGAC

speciesLookup.description: Species range lookup table with IUCN status and taxonomic class, used for biodiversity metric pre-calculation. Source: biomod species range model outputs with updated IUCN assessments.
speciesLookup.note: Local copy at data/biomod_spp_ranges_updatedIUCN.csv is gitignored; download from url above.
